definitions.explanation: A sudden, violent release of energy, typically with a loud noise and destruction.
A sudden, intense expression of emotion or energy; a rapid increase.

examples.japanese: ガス{爆発|ばくはつ}で{建物|たてもの}が{壊|こわ}れた。
examples.english: A gas explosion destroyed the building.

examples.japanese: {人口|じんこう}{爆発|ばくはつ}が{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: Population explosion has become a problem.

examples.japanese: {怒|いか}りが{爆発|ばくはつ}した。

notes:
USAGE: {爆発|ばくはつ} is used for literal explosions and figuratively for sudden outbursts or rapid increases.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{爆発|ばくはつ}する (to explode)
・{爆発|ばくはつ}を{起|お}こす (to cause an explosion)
・{爆発|ばくはつ}{的|てき} (explosive)
・{感情|かんじょう}が{爆発|ばくはつ}する (emotions explode)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{爆発|ばくはつ}{物|ぶつ} (explosives)
・{爆発|ばくはつ}{事故|じこ} (explosion accident)
・{爆発|ばくはつ}{的|てき}な{人気|にんき} (explosive popularity)
・{人口|じんこう}{爆発|ばくはつ} (population explosion)
・ガス{爆発|ばくはつ} (gas explosion)
・{核|かく}{爆発|ばくはつ} (nuclear explosion)

RELATED WORDS:
・{爆弾|ばくだん} - bomb
・{噴火|ふんか} - volcanic eruption
・{破裂|はれつ} - bursting, rupture
